req.title: Task title accepts unicode
req.statement: The system shall accept task titles containing UTF-8 characters and return them intact.

doc.reasoning: R-TASK-031 requires that task titles containing UTF-8 characters are accepted and returned intact. Three test cases are designed: (1) a positive EP test sending a multi-script Unicode title and asserting the exact title is echoed back with HTTP 201; (2) a negative NEG test sending a title that exceeds the 100-character max_length constraint (using Unicode chars to ensure the limit applies to character count, not bytes) and asserting HTTP 422; (3) a BVA boundary test sending a title of exactly 1 Unicode character (the minimum allowed length) and asserting HTTP 201 with the exact character returned. Additional assertions cover the exact status code constant (201 vs 200 vs 422), the exact title string round-trip, and the presence of required response fields (id, created_at) to kill constant-mutation and field-suppression mutants.

from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app
import app.database as _db
import app.models as _models

_models.Base.metadata.drop_all(bind=_db.engine)
_models.Base.metadata.create_all(bind=_db.engine)

client = TestClient(app)

unicode_title = "任务测试 مهمة 🚀 café"
payload = {"title": unicode_title, "description": None, "completed": False}

def test_unicode_title_positive_multiscript():
    r = client.post("/tasks/", json=payload)
    assert r.status_code == 201
    body = r.json()
    assert body["title"] == unicode_title
    assert isinstance(body["id"], int)
    assert body["completed"] == False
    assert "created_at" in body

from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app
import app.database as _db
import app.models as _models

_models.Base.metadata.drop_all(bind=_db.engine)
_models.Base.metadata.create_all(bind=_db.engine)

client = TestClient(app)

def test_unicode_title_roundtrip_various_scripts():
    titles = [
        "Задача",
        "משימה",
        "कार्य",
        "📝🔥",
    ]
    ids_seen = set()
    for title in titles:
        r = client.post("/tasks/", json={"title": title})
        assert r.status_code == 201
        body = r.json()
        assert body["title"] == title
        assert isinstance(body["id"], int)
        assert body["id"] not in ids_seen
        ids_seen.add(body["id"])
        assert body["completed"] == False
